name: GIRDER 格拉德 Fame press-fit T700/T800 Ultegra R8020
why_interesting: The earlier ROAD-section FAME: mechanical Ultegra R8020 2×11 hydraulic on a T700 + T800 BB386 aero frame with 50/60 mm wheels at an official ¥14,800, distinct from the 2025 T47 FAME.

facts.drivetrain: Shimano Ultegra R8020 mechanical 2×11; FC-R8000 52-36T 170 mm crank, CS-R8000 11-32T cassette; chain not listed
facts.frame: ROAD-section FAME T700 + T800 carbon aero frame and fork, 12 mm thru-axles, fully internal routing
facts.frame_material: T700 + T800 carbon frame and fork; fiber supplier and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: EPS-molded aero frame and fork with internal routing and press-fit bottom bracket
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or comparative stiffness evidence found
facts.bottom_bracket: BB386 press-fit system, 46 mm × 86 mm per the manufacturer's BB row
facts.wheels: Adler Augen wavy-rim ceramic-bearing wheels, 50 mm front / 60 mm rear
facts.tires: Maxxis M228 700C×28C skinwall folding tires with TPU tubes fitted; maximum clearance is not published
facts.cockpit: T700 + T800 integrated carbon handlebar with internal routing
facts.saddle: Selle Italia saddle and silicone bar tape
facts.sizes: S (476 mm), M (503 mm), L (533 mm); the size dimension is not labelled
facts.complete_weight_basis: Manufacturer-listed weight for this complete bike; size, pedals and weighing method are not stated
facts.historical_retail_context: A 2023-08-30 dealer post advertised a two-sided FAME with Ultegra R8020 hydraulic disc and 50/60 mm carbon wheels at CNY 16,800. That historical package and finish may differ from this ROAD-page build, and the amount is not a current price or purchase input.
facts.historical_owner_context: One owner reported in April 2024 that a FAME bought in summer 2023 with an Ultegra-level group cracked after the owner over-tightened the seat-post clamp without a torque wrench, and that GIRDER after-sales replaced the frame free of charge. This is a single uncorroborated account with a self-described cause; the Ultegra series and frame generation are not stated. It is not a defect-rate finding or a statement of current warranty terms. Use a torque wrench on carbon clamps and confirm warranty terms with the dealer.
